_doc: Attribute growth hooks (CAP-12). When `event` fires, the kid it names (payload.player, default 0) gains `amount` points of `attr` through the attr.grow action, until the attribute reaches `cap` (<= attrMax); growth is stored fractionally and shown rounded. `filter` must match payload fields exactly, `minDist` is a minimum payload.dist (the slingshot's target range). Events nobody emits yet simply never fire. level:up comes from characters/Progress.js (story 10.2).
